title: Cat Eye Gel Nail Polish Set 15ml Professional UV LED Soak Off Long Lasting Nail Art Color Gel for Nail Salon Home Use
description:
Features:
1. Professional cat eye gel nail polish with magnetic effect, creates stunning 3D cat eye patterns.
2. Long-lasting formula, stays up to 21 days without chipping or peeling.
3. Soak-off formula, easy to remove without damaging natural nails.
4. Compatible with all UV/LED nail lamps.
5. Safe, non-toxic, and odor-free formula.

How to Use:
1. Prep nails: clean, file, and apply base coat.
2. Apply a thin layer of cat eye gel.
3. While still wet, hold a cat eye magnet close to the nail for 5-10 seconds.
4. Cure under UV/LED lamp for 60 seconds.
5. Apply top coat and cure again.

Package Includes:
- 1 x Cat Eye Gel Nail Polish (15ml)

Storage: Keep away from direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry place.
selling_points: Stunning 3D cat eye magnetic effect with just one coat
Ultra long-lasting up to 21 days, no chipping or peeling
Easy soak-off removal, gentle on natural nails
Works with all UV and LED nail lamps
